title: Rotating Carousel Of Cups
name: rotating_carousel_cups
description: Three identical opaque cups stand on a round turntable; a ball is shown under the front cup before it lowers over the ball. The turntable then rotates 180 degrees, carrying all three cups around with it. When it stops, the cup that began at the front is now at the back; that cup lifts to reveal the ball still under it - the ball moved with its cup rotationally, rather than staying at the original front position.
